summary: Of 12 candidates, 1 was confirmed (F-05: a picked video goes up in one request that Node cuts at 300 s; re-run showed 408 after 330 s with 206 MB sent), 11 were corrected, 0 refuted and 0 unverified. verdicts.corrected_title: 207 failed units on the host: 206 stale experiment runs, and the GPU spend guard red on every run because of the retired RunPod provider
verdicts.corrected_today: Door status lists 207 failed units. 206 are transient experiment runs from Sept-Oct. The 207th, the GPU spend guard, fails every 2-3 minutes with exit 2 although paid admission is open, because it still queries the retired RunPod account. Nobody can tell a real money-guard block from this noise.
verdicts.corrected_proposal: One deploy window: reset-failed the transient units (door unit action). In the Pipeline, drop RunPod from the guard's required provider inventory (or exit 0 when the only blocker is a retired provider), so the guard goes green and a real block turns it red. Make door status list repo units first and count transient ones separately.
